implementation: Personal Identity Verification Application Library on Hitachi MULTOS OS
description: The Personal Identify Verification Application on Hitachi Multos 4.236aXb provides enhanced functionality, flexibility and security based on the MULTOS and conforms to FIPS201 specification. The HITACHI MULTOS 4.236aXb is a single chip module for smart cards with dual interfaces which is compliant with the MULTOS Standard.
